open_ocean_definition.criterion: Every 10 min TC-track point in a retained segment is at least 200 km from land.

evaluation_aggregation.surface_episode_statistic: median over validation episodes within each training seed
evaluation_aggregation.surface_seed_statistic: arithmetic mean of the ten seed-level episode medians
evaluation_aggregation.subsurface_episode_statistic: arithmetic mean over validation episodes within each training seed
evaluation_aggregation.subsurface_seed_statistic: arithmetic mean of the ten seed-level episode means
evaluation_aggregation.uncertainty: sample standard deviation across the ten seed-level values

underwater_observation_metrics.experienced_current: time mean of interpolated current speed along each SUV trajectory, averaged over the fleet
underwater_observation_metrics.geometric_coverage: unique 0.25-degree grid cells visited by the fleet union times cell area
underwater_observation_metrics.current_weighted_coverage: episode fleet-mean experienced current multiplied by episode geometric coverage

surface_policy_and_formation.policy: single MLP policy for the whole SUV formation
surface_policy_and_formation.action: one joint 2-D formation action broadcast to every SUV
surface_policy_and_formation.formation_radius_normalization: Ring, Line, Grid, and V are all normalized to the same mean formation radius of 100 km.

formation_comparison.metric_aggregation: median over validation episodes for training seed 0
formation_comparison.claim_limit: No statistical claim of a universally best formation.

traditional_algorithms.underwater_evaluation: 40 held-out TCs x 10 deployment seeds per depth-speed setting
traditional_algorithms.surface_metric_aggregation: episode median; deterministic planners have no training-seed variance
traditional_algorithms.subsurface_metric_aggregation: episode arithmetic mean; deployment seeds are validation realizations

track_coverage_issue.status_note: All segments in data/segments_primary_400.csv satisfy t0 > 0 and remain within the final valid IBTrACS record. Pre-400 checkpoints are not primary; the current rigid-formation training uses the corrected 400-TC data.
